args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: In src/components/UploadForm.tsx, the onChange handler for the file input updates file via setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null) but does not reset the upload error state (problem), leaving stale error messages on screen when a new file is chosen.

label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/components/UploadForm.tsx, the onChange handler for the file input updates file via setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null) but does not reset the upload error state (problem), leaving stale error messages on screen when a new file is chosen.
